name: Bank Respublika
verdict: Private Azerbaijani bank: the Quliyev brothers hold about 90% between them, with SIDT and other private shareholders holding the rest. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Front shirt sponsor since 2019/20, renewed July 2022 (cooperation since 2018); the club's Masazır ground is named Bank Respublika Arena. Shareholders are private individuals (Quliyev family ~90%) and Sparkassen International Development Trust; no state or fund stake is reported. Proposed in PR for issue #436.
